items.title: Add rebalance job models and states
items.summary: Add preview-independent 2026-08-01 rebalance job properties, status and provisioning-state unions, plus additive update properties for import and export jobs.

inferenceResults.rationale: The new provisioning and operational status unions are introduced only with the new rebalance job models in 2026-08-01. They do not replace an existing REST or SDK contract.
